adapters.description: Enforces the persistence/import-isolation subset of DDD-003. It does not claim complete Layer Isolation coverage.

proposal.summary: Move infrastructure access behind an application/domain port instead of importing persistence from domain/application code.
suggestedActions: Introduce or extend a narrow repository/application port at the owning boundary.
Move Prisma or other infrastructure-specific access into server/infrastructure or the host composer.
Update callers to depend on the port and re-run package-internal-boundary-audit.mjs.
